title: A 728-Foot Crater Just Appeared on the Moon. NASA Found It

scenes.text: A new crater appeared on the Moon, 728 feet wide.
NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter spotted a bright splash of debris around it.
The impact happened in 2024, sometime between April and May.
Something about the size of a building slammed into the surface.
It is the largest new crater ever found in our solar system.
Impacts this big happen about once a century. A brand new crater, 728 feet wide.

description:
A new crater appeared on the Moon, 728 feet wide.
NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter spotted it in 2025. It formed in 2024 and is the largest newly formed crater ever identified in the solar system.
What would you name it?

first_comment: Bonus: about 140 coffee-table-sized rocks hit the Moon every year, but they make craters only about 30 feet wide.
